notes: The Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the catalogue, so it is a new part type with the same header layout as the Uno R3.

The breadboard in the diagram is drawn with rows j-f in the top half and e-a in the bottom half. The catalogue calls the f-j half bank 'b', so the LED circuit is in the top half of the picture, which is bank 'b'.

Resistor: column 3 to column 6, row h. Green wire: pin 2 to 3b.g, in the same column strip as the resistor's first leg. LED: the longer, bent leg (anode) is in column 6 with the resistor. The shorter leg (cathode) is in column 8. Black wire: Arduino GND (next to pin 13) to 8b.h, in the LED cathode strip.
LED anode and cathode are assigned from the leg shapes in the image: the bent, longer leg is the anode.
The tutorial says the built-in LED can be used instead. The external LED circuit is built here because it is in the diagram.
The Serial Monitor screenshot and the sketch need no hardware. A1 is read in software with nothing connected, so it has no edge.
